corrections.text: The article says the release notes do not state whether HydraFusion is generally available to all Copilot plans. The release notes label it "HydraFusion model orchestration (Research Preview)" and say "Eligible users with preview features enabled can select HydraFusion in the model picker," so it is not generally available.

The release notes mark multi-folder sessions, remote delegation, shared worktree folders (git.worktreeSymlinkFolders) and persistent progress as "(Experimental)". The remote delegation tools are off by default and apply to the Agents window only. The article does not state this.
